errors.text: The hypothesis locates the antiferromagnetic interaction primarily across the fcc/C14 interface, whereas the target mechanism concerns antiparallel coupling between Fe/Co/Ni and Ti sublattices and does not establish the C14 phase as an antiferromagnetic interfacial magnetic sink.
The proposed 400 K-to-1084 K measurement range and 400 K hysteresis comparison cannot isolate the phase-specific transitions near 168 K and 214 K.
